name: Bhagavad Gita 2.20
text:
न जायते म्रियते वा कदाचिन्
नायं भूत्वा भविता वा न भूयः ।
अजो नित्यः शाश्वतोऽयं पुराणो
न हन्यते हन्यमाने शरीरे ॥
meaning: The deepest self is not born and does not die. It is described as eternal, and not destroyed when the body perishes.
purpose: A philosophical verse for contemplating the eternal self and the impermanence of the body. It can offer a spiritual perspective during grief.
supports: Making room for grief; reflecting on mortality; remembering without denying the pain of absence.
when: During bereavement, or quiet reflection on loss.
note: Never use this verse to tell someone not to grieve. It offers a spiritual perspective, not an instruction to suppress sadness.
